title: Jacques Vallée co-opted in the 1980s

tellings.quote: because in the 80s he got taken in by that organization.

plain: A researcher named Steven Greer, who talks often about secret UFO knowledge, says that a well-known UFO researcher, Jacques Vallée, was won over by a certain organization in the 1980s. In Greer's words, Vallée "got taken in" by that group, though Greer does not name it in this telling. If true, it would mean one of the field's best-known thinkers was steered by others.
